chars.GIRL: a young Moroccan woman in her early twenties, long curly dark hair in a high ponytail, round gold-rimmed glasses, wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie
chars.NARRATOR: a skinny young Moroccan man about 26, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a faded olive-green bomber jacket over a plain white t-shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. GIRL on a video call, seen straight on as if through the other person's phone camera, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, leaning toward the camera with an open hand gesture and a big eager mischievous smile, pitching an exciting idea. Behind her a bright Casablanca apartment bedroom with a shelf of notebooks and fairy lights. Subject centered, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR sitting on a thin floor mattress in a small bare room with cracked plaster walls in a poor Moroccan neighbourhood, holding his phone in front of him, jaw dropped and eyes wide in total shock. Medium shot, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR in his small bare room, embarrassed, one hand covering half his face and the other waving 'no no' while holding the phone, shy awkward smile. Medium shot, centered, plain background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. GIRL at a small desk in her bright Casablanca bedroom, excitedly pointing at a laptop showing a colourful abstract book cover with no letters, dreaming big, sparkle in her eyes. Medium shot, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR jumping up from his mattress in a tiny bare room, phone in one hand, other fist raised in joy, eyes huge, imagining money: a few banknotes floating around him in a playful cartoon way. Full figure centered, calm edges.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. GIRL filming herself with a phone on a ring light stand in her bedroom, confident influencer pose, a drawing tablet in her other hand with an abstract book cover sketch (no letters). Medium shot, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR at night writing fast in a notebook at a small plastic table under a single lamp in his modest room, a glass of mint tea beside him, focused and motivated. Medium shot, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR sitting on his mattress reading something on his phone with a frown, one eyebrow raised, puzzled and suspicious expression, scratching his head. Close medium shot, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: 2D illustration, vertical. NARRATOR alone at night in his dark room, face lit only by the glow of his phone screen, eyes widening in disbelief as if discovering a shocking secret, tense suspenseful mood. Close medium shot, face visible, centered.
